issue_comments.body:
Could you also make `ShiftedHom` an abbrev instead of a `def`. Then, the `AddCommGroup` and `Module` instances on this type could be removed. I have tried this, and overall, it improves automation. A few proofs should break, but the fix should be easy (typically some `erw [Iso.homToEquiv_apply]` would no longer be necessary as they would be applied automatically by `dsimp`).
If there is any proof which may seem to require a more elaborate fix, you may just keep it as a `sorry`, and I could try to have a second look at it.
@joelriou I think it is successfully changed into an abbrev, any further suggestions?
